The decisive mistake was WebSurfer's at step 8.

At step 6, WebSurfer was told to look up DHL rates. It instead clicked into the FedEx rate calculator. This began a pattern of not doing what was asked: it kept working in the FedEx form, and later clicked "International" and the destination-country dropdown on the USPS calculator instead of entering the details. DHL and USPS rates were never obtained, so the correct USPS price of 41.75 was never found.

The Orchestrator also made weak choices, such as routing the lookup to the Assistant at step 13. Even so, the failure began with WebSurfer's off-task action at step 8.

AGENT: WebSurfer
STEP: 8
